editorial.blurb: Gyumon brings the interactive joy of Japanese tabletop grilling to Oak Park with impeccably fresh meats, thoughtful service, and a smoke-free experience that won't linger on your clothes.
editorial.insiderTip: Book ahead for the all-you-can-eat sets (Gold at $45, Diamond at $55 with premium wagyu and tongue); you can comfortably finish in 90 minutes, and the staff will swap out your grill if it's underperforming.
signatureDishes: Bubble tea (matcha strawberry, grape jasmine with cheese foam)
